Graduate Programmes
Graduate programmes
The LKCMedicine PhD by Research Programme​
The LKCMedicine PhD by Research Programme​ admits students from a variety of backgrounds and exposes them to a range of topics and disciplines.
Holistic Palliative Care Programme (HoPE)
The Holistic Palliative Care Programme (HoPE) is a programme designed to be a single and stackable training pathway to the palliative care workforce.
Artificial Intelligence in Medicine
The Master of Science, Artificial Intelligence in Medicine is a cutting-edge programme designed to merge the realms of healthcare and AI seamlessly.
ASPIRE Master of Psychology (Clinical)
Transform your psychology practice with ASPIRE, a flexible, competency-based work-study model developed by LKCMedicine and NHG Health to develop the next generation of registered clinical psychologists.
Primary Care Dermatology
Designed in collaboration with the National Skin Centre, the Master of Science in Primary Care Dermatology equips healthcare professionals with advanced, practice-ready skills to confidently manage skin conditions in community settings.
Ethics for Nurses
A first-of-its-kind clinical ethics programme that empowers nurses in Singapore to lead ethical decision-making across patient care, practice, and policy.
Graduate Diploma in Sports Medicine
The GDSM programme is designed for medical doctors who are interested in extending their qualifications and training in this growing area of need.
Physiotherapy and Rehabilitation Health
Designed and delivered collaboratively by the Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine, Nanyang Technological University and the National Health Group (NHG Health). This programme equips physiotherapists with practice-ready competencies across acute, rehabilitation and community care settings.
Master of Science in Science of Learning
LKCMedicine in partnership with National Institute of Education: Advances in biology and neuroscience show how our brains and cognitive development are shaped by learning experiences and the environment. The Master of Science in Science of Learning is a distinctive interdisciplinary programme involving National Institute of Education and LKC School of Medicine. Students will acquire a strong foundation in science of learning, and learn how the latest advancements in neuroscience, cognitive science, artificial intelligence technologies bear on fundamental questions of education--how people learn and the tools we can use to optimise learning. Application window opens every May – June for start of studies in January the following year. There is one intake per year.
Short Courses
Sports Medicine Theory Course
The Sports Medicine Theory Course (SMTC) is for medical doctors who would like to have a fundamental understanding of sports medicine.
Musculoskeletal (MSK) Ultrasound Course
The MSK Ultrasound course is designed for nurses and allied health professionals (AHPs) who are interested in expanding their skills in diagnosing and managing upper and lower limb pathologies.
Professional Certificate in Musculoskeletal Advanced Practice Physiotherapy (MSK APP)
Jointly organised by Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine and Tan Tock Seng Hospital, the MSK APP course is a modular programme designed to develop the knowledge, clinical reasoning, management capabilities, professional, ethical and legal understanding for safe, independent MSK advanced practice.
